## Fios
- [Minas Lã Stretch](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/minas-la-stretch/): 97% viscose · 3% elastano; 2/29 Nm; 68,97 Tex / 689,66 dtex.
- [Stretch Light](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/stretch-light/): 98% viscose · 2% elastano; 2/29 Nm; 68,97 Tex / 689,66 dtex.
- [Nevada](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/nevada/): 70% viscose · 30% poliamida; 18 Nm; 55,56 Tex / 555,56 dtex.
- [Vem Verão](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/vem-verao/): 100% viscose/rayon; 2/38 Nm; 52,63 Tex / 526,32 dtex.
- [Rayonflex](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/rayonflex/): 68% viscose/rayon · 32% poliamida; 2/40 Nm; 50,00 Tex / 500,00 dtex.
- [Catavento](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/catavento/): 71% viscose · 25% algodão · 4% elastano; 2/34 Nm; 58,82 Tex / 588,24 dtex.
- [Dicotone](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/di-cotone/): 97% algodão · 3% elastano; 2/34 Nm; 58,82 Tex / 588,24 dtex.
- [Tocapele](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/toca-pele/): 98% viscose · 2% elastano; 1/34 Nm; 29,41 Tex / 294,12 dtex.
- [Fashion Raion](https://glarmelina-wq.github.io/lumafios/fios/fashion-raion/): 80% rayon · 20% poliamida; 2/50 Nm; 40,00 Tex / 400,00 dtex.
